race.comment: LOVE RUSTLER (3) resumes as the horse with the strongest upside, having been beaten two lengths at Geelong before the spell when favourite and hampered near the 300m. The close Avoca trial says she's back in good health and that last-start form reads well enough for this. PRESTIGE MADDY (5) returns off two trials and was last seen running on for third at Bendigo after being held up, so she has the right sort of place profile if forward enough first-up. HEAVY IS THE HEAD (1) struggled at Pakenham but had been coming along well prior and has claims. TORZANNIE (7) was an eye-catcher fresh and is sure to have come on from that. Have to keep in mind.
